hook: Do you stay up late scrolling your phone every night? Here is what it secretly does to your brain and body!
caption:
Ratri late ga padukovadam manaku teliyakundaane mana health ni padu chestundi! 🛑 Brain toxins clear avvavu, immunity padipotundi, roju antha neerasam ga untundi. Ee chinnari marpu tho mee health ni kapadukondi. 

Share this with someone who sleeps late every night! 💤✨

#SleepHealth #LateNightHabits #HealthyLiving #TeluguHealthTips #BrainHealth #WellnessJourney #SleepBetter #SelfCare
poster_caption:
Ever wonder why sleeping in on weekends actually leaves you feeling more exhausted? 😴📉

When you consistently push back your sleep and wake times, you throw your internal master clock completely out of balance. Here is what is happening inside your biology:

• Cortisol Spike: Triggers unnecessary physical stress.
• Insulin Resistance: Wrecks your metabolic glucose control.
• Detox Block: Halts essential brain waste clearance.

Protect your energy by locking in a consistent wake-up time starting tomorrow.

📌 Save this guide for your daily health routine!

#SleepScience #CircadianRhythm #Biohacking #RecoveryTips #SleepHealth #WellnessHabits #BrainHealth #DailyWellness
